scope: Complete native audio, transcripts and provenance for the seven user-specified families; source staging only
copy_engine: Stock Hugging Face hf download, curl for public RuDevices archives, native MinIO mc; tar only for unchanged local source snapshots
operational_orchestration: Shell launches the stock CLIs, checks checksums, routes official test files and records progress; no new Python dataset adapter, uploader or trainer.
bulk_download_concurrency: Golos and both original Balalaika jobs resume with stock HF download concurrency defaults after initial limited-concurrency startup; GPU jobs are untouched.
credentials: Existing authorized HF token is read privately by the operational jobs; never committed or printed. Existing S3 admin environment is supplied by systemd EnvironmentFile.
tls: HF and MinIO both verify TLS with a bundle containing the OS public CAs and the private MinIO CA; no insecure option
integrity: Pinned source revision plus upstream LFS SHA256 when available, independent local SHA256, full S3 readback SHA256. Completion receipt is written after all selected files pass.
cleanup: Only freshly downloaded large Balalaika temporary files are removed, individually after complete S3 readback. Existing source directories and original labels remain unchanged.
official_test_routing: Golos official test shards and SOVA validation/test Parquet are kept in speech-benchmarks, denied to training/ingest credentials.
initial_attempts: First units were stopped to correct TSV empty-field parsing before import; subsequent download attempts failed because the private-only SSL_CERT_FILE replaced public trust. Failed receipts remain preserved. New jobs use the combined verified CA bundle.

working_mirror.integrity: Check complete ZIP byte count, native unzip CRC, original manifest SHA256, and complete S3 readback SHA256 before marking copied.
working_mirror.note: Working public mirror verified with actual ZIP and WAV bytes. Repacked ZIP is not byte-identical to the author TAR; coverage equivalence to the HF copy remains unproven.

original_archive.initial_archive_attempt: Native curl initially did not follow the provider redirect, producing an empty temporary file. SHA256 check rejected it before S3 upload. The current job follows redirects with TLS verification; the failed receipt is preserved.
original_archive.provider_failure: TLS-verified probes on dev and exp receive HEAD 200 but range GET 206 with zero body/curl exit 18; bounded ordinary GET also yields no data. No archive was admitted or uploaded. The complete pinned HF source is independently copied and verified.
original_archive.note: Native original enables subsequent coverage comparison; no missing-sample conclusion solely from differing reported hours.

corpora.selection: Complete pinned source, both crowd and farfield; original train/test boundaries retained

corpora.existing_source_pools: Original local stress audio/labels and completed native partition exports already copied; see native-corpus-catalog.json and balalaika-native-archive-verification.json

sources.exclusion_reason: Derived speech-codec caches, not original audio/transcripts needed for this ASR data task; complete source inventory retained.

corpora.selection: Complete pinned repository including paired audio, original text variants, samples and question/prosody data; unpaired text remains explicitly unpaired
All files of the pinned native source; preserve raw audio, annotations, source tools and index without executing dataset-provided code
corpora.note: Full source inventory is not a training admission, complete quality assessment, or proof that every catalogued utterance has usable ground truth.

research_queue: Separate local/web source reports and supplemental native archives; additional datasets are not substitutes for the seven requested families.
publication_gate: No unified portable training release before an approved format adapter and explicit benchmark exclusion registry; native source staging does not change training_eligible flags.
